claude_proposed_widenings.name: teleport.destination = "designated_sanctuary"
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Word of Recall teleports to a previously designated sanctuary — a named prior-cast anchor point, not a visible unoccupied space. The only existing destination variant is "unoccupied_visible_space", which is semantically wrong and would produce a dishonest trace.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "you instantly teleport to a previously designated sanctuary"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: Attachment for caster + up to N companions (group teleport)
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Word of Recall moves the caster and up to 5 willing creatures within 5 feet as one simultaneous event. No current attachment kind captures "self plus choose_up_to N within range" in a single phase. Dimension Door modeled only the caster; the companion was silently dropped. Dropping 5 passengers here would be a more egregious lie.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You and up to five willing creatures within 5 feet of you instantly teleport"

claude_proposed_widenings.name: sanctuary_designation preparation mechanic
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The spell doubles as its own setup: casting it at a sacred location registers that location as the caster's sanctuary. This is a stateful preparation mechanic — a prior cast whose effect persists as a character-state anchor — with no analog in any current phase family or activation shape. It is not a separate spell, not a ritual, and not an anchored_trigger; it is a cast-time side-effect that stores a destination for future casts of the same spell.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You must designate a location, such as a temple, as a sanctuary by casting this spell there."
